channel.title: kakol.pro — field notes
channel.description: Field notes by Michał Kąkol — systems, experiments, AI, and the return of the home page.

item.title: The interesting unit is not the prompt. It is the workspace.
item.description: Prompts are disposable; the durable, agent-readable workspace is the real unit. Plus the failure mode nobody demos: presence is not use.

item.title: Experimentation as an error-surfacing system
item.description: A p=5e-6 result that collapsed to p=0.59 once three plausible errors came off — and why trust is an error-surfacing system, not a feeling.

item.title: The Return of the Homepage
item.description: Why I built a plain homepage in 2026 instead of living on platforms: ownership, a deliberate filter, a retro surface over modern guts.

item.title: Am I Still a Data Scientist?
item.description: From data scientist to manager to AI-native builder: the honest maker-vs-manager tension, and the one thread that actually runs through all of it.

item.title: The Shame of Using AI
item.description: The shame of letting a model write the draft is aimed at the wrong thing. The value was never the typing — it's the loop, the verification, the memory.
